tasks.label: Ruff: Format current branch
tasks.command: git diff --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR origin/main -- '*.py' | xargs -0 -r uv run --frozen ruff format

tasks.label: Ruff: Check current branch
tasks.command: git diff --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR origin/main -- '*.py' | xargs -0 -r uv run --frozen ruff format --check
